content: Advance M0100 from fixture-level foundation to a verified CPU-backed CUDA/NVML Add/Copy vertical slice, closing the smallest remaining W0102-W0106 implementation and qualification gates without weakening the declared contracts or release evidence boundary.

Applied D0009 as an implementation gate: Ubuntu 20.04/glibc 2.31 is the generic Linux ABI floor; newer Ubuntu and Rocky rows remain qualification environments, not additional ABI targets or toolchain variants.

Separated administrator AOT publication from mutable per-UID cache reconciliation and aligned the private compiler users tree to mode 0700, preserving the D0014 cache boundary under service-account execution.
CPU compiler and daemon changes passed the targeted cache, execution-mode, and compiler-pipeline regressions; the daemon million-noop stress target and the complete 65-test CTest suite passed.

Packaging owns the canonical provider/complete DEB, RPM, and tar construction. Its staging gate rejects non-system interpreters, RPATH/RUNPATH, non-allowlisted DT_NEEDED entries, Nix store paths, and GLIBC symbols newer than 2.31.

The complete-package builder validates Ubuntu 20.04 target SDK and generic toolchain manifests, including matching SDK build and package-set identities; release fixtures receive the same ELF/glibc gate before container qualification.

Digest-pinned offline package matrices passed all eight complete rows and all eight provider rows across Ubuntu 20.04, 22.04, 24.04, and Rocky 9; fixture evidence reports the system loader and glibc 2.14/2.2 maxima, and two independent builds matched DEB, RPM, and tar SHA-256 values.

The glibc/package boundary is verified but W0101 remains active for Intel/AMD reference hosts, the native NixOS row, stock-tool and optimized-lowering qualification, and remaining fault/quota/soak gates; temporary build and evidence trees are disposable.
